name: sleepclaw
description: Local sleep investigation, Apple Health analysis tools and evidence-aware follow-up.

interface.shortDescription: Investigate sleep with local health data.
interface.longDescription: Import selected Apple Health exports locally, clarify uncertain recollections, inspect sleep and physiology evidence, and save a versioned report with one action. Uses the host assistant; no second model connection required.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $sleep-investigation to help me understand my sleep.
